# opnsense_auth_user (Resource)

Local OPNsense user account.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique local username.

### Optional

- `authorized_keys` (String) SSH authorized keys for this user.
- `comment` (String) Informational comment.
- `disabled` (Boolean) When enabled, disables authentication for this user. Defaults to `false`.
- `email` (String) Informational email address.
- `expires` (String) Optional account expiration date.
- `fullname` (String) Informational full name.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Optional local-login password. It is never returned by OPNsense.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the user.
